name: Virat Leasing Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Virat Leasing Ltd is in the business of financing and investment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VLL is a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit taking Non-Banking Finance Company, which operates in West Bengal and specializes in making investments in shares and Securities, extending loans and advances and other financial services activities, except insurance and pension, funding activities, etc.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 85.6 days to 55.0 days
cons: Stock is trading at 5.61 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.82% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.02% over last 3 years.
